picks.headline: Snapchat has a new GenAI-powered ‘Chat to Song’ feature
picks.excerpt: Earlier this year, we wrote about the ‘text-to-song’ craze on TikTok, where people were feeding their message-threads into Suno to generate songs – some of which went viral.
picks.rationale: A mass-market messaging app turns the viral 'text-to-song' trend into a built-in feature, so generative music now ships inside a mainstream social platform instead of being a niche tool.

picks.headline: Akai iMPC Pro 2 (iOS/macOS): update 3.0 brings AUv3 plugin support, stem separation and more
picks.excerpt: Retronyms released the Akai iMPC Pro 2.0 update 3.0, which lets you host the app as an AUv3 plugin, use stem separation, and more.
picks.rationale: A concrete release that producers can install today: AI stem separation plus AUv3 hosting in a mobile/desktop MPC, which puts sample-flipping from full mixes on an iPad.

picks.headline: Italy’s Sanremo Music Festival Places Strict Limits on the Use of AI
picks.excerpt: Italy's Sanremo Music Festival has announced a collection of seemingly strict rules concerning competitors' use of AI.
picks.rationale: One of Europe's biggest song contests puts written AI limits on competitors, a new eligibility precedent that songwriters entering competitions have to check against their workflow.

picks.headline: Scammers have been inserting fake songs onto real artist's pages on Spotify and other platforms
picks.excerpt: A distribution loophole lets scammers collect royalties uploading fake songs to profiles for real bands.
picks.rationale: A distribution loophole that lets fake uploads land on real artists' profiles hits every independent artist's catalogue and royalties. Distinct from the UMG v. DistroKid suit already published. Enrichment must confirm the body has an AI-generated-track angle.

picks.headline: 6 Stem Separation Tool Options For Audio Pros In 2026
picks.excerpt: Real-time plugin or offline service? We compare six stem separation tools for mix and post work, and flag which ones keep client audio off the cloud.
picks.rationale: A practical buyer's comparison of AI stem splitters that flags which tools keep client audio off the cloud. It helps with choosing a tool now that Pro Tools, DP12, LUNA and iMPC all ship one.
